blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Опять и еще ___ (жестокий) погибал.
exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее. This comparative form is the same for all genders and the plural. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–81.  ·  From Николай Лесков, «Очарованный странник».
